entries.title: Deterministic matching rollout proof: operator verifies suggestions, approvals, typeahead, and privacy gates end to end
verificationCommands: cd apps/web && pnpm smoke:catalog-matching-rollout -- --environment local --confirm-environment local --base-url http://127.0.0.1:3000
vercel env run --environment production -- pnpm --dir apps/web run smoke:catalog-matching-rollout -- --environment production --confirm-environment production --base-url https://over.garden
